title: Single-cell transcriptome profiling highlights the role of APP in blood vessels in assessing the risk of patients with proliferative diabetic retinopathy developing Alzheimer's disease.
tissue: human fibrovascular membrane (FVM), human hippocampus vessels, human retina, mouse retina
reason: Paper provides multi-sample scRNA-seq from PDR (2 subjects) and AD hippocampus (9 subjects) along with human retina bulk RNA-seq, suitable for cross-disease vascular studies. No custom code repository; data deposited in GEO. Moderate relevance for integration benchmarks as datasets are from different diseases and tissues with multiple samples.
methods_summary: Seurat v4.3.0 for preprocessing, clustering, and normalization; GSEA (KEGG) for enrichment; CellChat v1.6.1 for cell-cell communication; Monocle for pseudotime trajectory analysis; correlation analysis with Spearman/Pearson methods.
